title: PRIMO : Precision immunosuppressive drug monitoring in liver transplantation: a randomized control tria
official: PRIMO : Precision immunosuppressive drug monitoring in liver transplantation: a randomized control trial
summary: Main objective: We aim to test the double hypothesis that a precision medicine care program is non-inferior in terms of acute rejection and graft loss free survival and is superior when considering the rate of complications compared with standard of care immunosuppressive drugs treatment in liver transplantation.
conditions: Immunosuppressive treatment in the context of liver transplantation
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. IC1 - Adult patients receiving a de novo liver graft
2. IC2 - Eligible for treatment with tacrolimus and mycophenolic acid
3. IC3 - Effective contraception in accordance with CTFG recommendations
4. IC4 - Having received oral and written information about the protocol and having signed a consent form to take part in this research.
5. IC5 - Affiliated to a social security scheme
Exclusion criteria:
1. EC1 - Combined transplantation
2. EC2 - Retransplantation
3. EC3 - Patients treated de novo with a modified-release formulation
4. EC4 - Pregnant women or planning to become pregnant during the time of the study, breastfeeding women
5. EC5 - Adults under legal protection (safeguard of justice, curatorship, guardianship), persons deprived of their liberty,  minors, persons unable to express their consent.
